requirements.requirement: File Currency Transaction Report (CTR) for cash transactions exceeding $10,000
File Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) when transactions suggest money laundering, fraud, or terrorist financing
Detect and report structuring — breaking transactions to avoid CTR threshold
Verify customer identity using documentary or non-documentary methods before account opening
Identify and verify beneficial owners holding 25% or more equity in legal entity customers
Apply Enhanced Due Diligence for politically exposed persons (PEPs) and high-risk customers
Screen all customers and transactions against OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list
Do not discriminate in credit decisions based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex, marital status, or age
Disclose annual percentage rate (APR), finance charges, and total payment amount before credit extension
Provide adverse action notice with specific reasons when denying credit application
Calculate Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) capital ratio with minimum 4.5% requirement
Monitor Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) with minimum 100% requirement
Calculate and report leverage ratio with minimum 3% requirement
Maintain internal controls over financial reporting with audit trail
Preserve financial records and audit documentation for minimum required period
Implement and maintain a written AML compliance program with designated compliance officer
Investigate and resolve unauthorized electronic fund transfer claims within 10 business days
Provide privacy notice to customers describing information sharing practices
Ensure accuracy of consumer credit reporting data and investigate disputes within 30 days
Prohibit unfair, deceptive, or abusive acts or practices (UDAAP) in consumer financial services
Conduct ongoing transaction monitoring commensurate with customer risk profile
Provide free copy of appraisal for first-lien mortgage applications
Calculate debt-to-income ratio correctly including all recurring obligations
Assess loan-to-value ratio against regulatory limits for property type
Identify and report funnel account activity patterns in correspondent banking
